buzzRounds.topic: Tyler Herro scores 50, then the Bucks finally win
buzzRounds.whatHappened: Tyler Herro scored 50 points with 11 rebounds for the Milwaukee Bucks on Saturday, November 21, making 15 of 23 shots and 7 of 12 three-pointers, but Philadelphia won 132-129.
buzzRounds.whyCare: Two nights later, on November 23, Milwaukee beat Toronto 116-111 to snap a 13-game losing streak, the second-longest in franchise history, and is now 2-16, per ESPN.
buzzRounds.youCouldSay: Tyler Herro scored 50 for the Bucks against the 76ers on Saturday and they still lost 132-129, but Milwaukee finally ended a 13-game losing streak by beating Toronto on Monday.

details.name: Tyler Herro
details.buzz: Herro scored 50 points with 11 rebounds and 7 assists in a 132-129 loss at Philadelphia on November 21, then had 32 as Milwaukee snapped its 13-game losing streak on November 23.
